$comment: Advisories CI accepts for a limited time, each for named packages only. Read by scripts/audit-gate.mts. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check and a reviewBy date; an expired entry fails CI. See docs/DECISIONS.md, 'An advisory with no fix'.

exceptions.title: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
exceptions.reason: No fixed release exists (every version up to 4.0.7, the latest). picomatch is reached only through @rollup/plugin-commonjs, which @sentry/nextjs loads in its webpack wrapping loader (build/cjs/config/loaders/wrappingLoader.js) at build time. The patterns it matches come from our own build configuration, never from a request, so a visitor cannot send it a pattern. Downgrading Sentry to 8.38.0, npm's only suggestion, would drop three major versions of error monitoring.
